blocking.section: CI/CD, GitOps and development tools; Request and response transformation; Routing; Traffic management
blocking.issue: Acceptance criterion 7 is not met. It says every Ruralz mechanism must name a kind, Policy or Filter defined in docs/architecture/02-configuration-model.md. The Hot-reload in development mechanism names none of them. Bundle, Node, Revision and Hot Reload are canonical terms, not kinds, Policy types or Filters. Seven more mechanism cells name only bare fields and leave out the kind that owns them. This is the same defect as L3-1, and it is repeated here because this lens must evaluate every acceptance criterion.
blocking.evidence: Line 124, Hot-reload in development: '`ruralz dev run` watches a Bundle; the Node activates each change by an atomic swap of the active Revision's compiled snapshot (Hot Reload)'. Bare fields: Aggregation '`composition.mode: aggregate` runs steps in parallel ...'; Data transformation 'Composition step fields `target`, `select`, `rename`, `group` and `collection`'; Sequential proxy '`composition.mode: sequential`; ...'; Workflows '`composition.mode: sequential` with per-step `when` ...'; Conditional routing '`composition.mode: conditional` with CEL step `when`'; URL rewrite 'Composition step `path` or `pathExpression`'; Customizable HTTP circuit breaker '`circuitBreaker.failureWhen` CEL over `response.status` and `error`'.
blocking.fix: Hot-reload in development: '`ruralz dev run` watches a Bundle of `Gateway`, `Route`, `Upstream` and `Policy` files; the Node activates each change by an atomic swap of the active Revision's compiled snapshot (Hot Reload)'. Put `Route` before each composition cell: '`Route` `composition.mode: aggregate` ...', '`Route` composition step fields ...', '`Route` composition step `path` or `pathExpression`', and so on. Write '`Upstream` `circuitBreaker.failureWhen` CEL over ...'. None of these edits needs a new field.

non_blocking.section: Request and response transformation (Automatic output encoding row); Open questions (OQ-krakend-ee-parity-matrix-2)
non_blocking.suggestion: Two statements say KrakenD re-encodes output to XML, YAML or a negotiated format, and neither cites a source. The row reads 'Partial parity: XML, YAML and negotiated output per OQ-krakend-ee-parity-matrix-2'. The Open question reads 'as KrakenD's automatic output encoding does'. The research supports the claim: krakend-config-model.md section 3 lists the `output_encoding` values json, yaml, xml and negotiate from https://www.krakend.io/schema/v2.13/krakend.json. Append '([source](https://www.krakend.io/schema/v2.13/krakend.json))' to the row's Notes/ADR cell.
